OPEN WELLS INITIATIVE

JOB TITLE: FIELD COORDINATOR, WATER & SANITATION
LOCATION: TAMALE, NORTHERN REGION, GHANA (WITH 50% TRAVEL TO RURAL SITES)
CONTRACT: 18 MONTHS, FULL TIME, POSSIBILITY OF EXTENSION
REPORTS TO: COUNTRY PROGRAMME MANAGER

ABOUT THE ROLE
YOU WILL COORDINATE THE DAY-TO-DAY DELIVERY OF OUR BOREHOLE REHABILITATION
PROGRAMME ACROSS 40 COMMUNITIES, WORKING WITH LOCAL CONTRACTORS, DISTRICT
ASSEMBLIES AND COMMUNITY WATER COMMITTEES.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- PLAN AND SUPERVISE SITE WORKS, ENSURING QUALITY AND SAFETY STANDARDS
- TRAIN WATER COMMITTEES ON BASIC MAINTENANCE AND FEE COLLECTION
- COLLECT MONITORING DATA (FUNCTIONALITY, WATER QUALITY TESTS) MONTHLY
- MANAGE A FIELD TEAM OF 4 TECHNICIANS
- WRITE SHORT MONTHLY PROGRESS UPDATES FOR THE COUNTRY OFFICE

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- DIPLOMA OR DEGREE IN CIVIL ENGINEERING, WASH OR RELATED FIELD
- 3+ YEARS IN COMMUNITY WATER PROJECTS
- FLUENT ENGLISH AND DAGBANI; HAUSA AN ADVANTAGE
- VALID MOTORBIKE LICENCE

SALARY: GHS 9,500 - 11,000 PER MONTH PLUS FIELD ALLOWANCE AND HEALTH COVER

TO APPLY: SEND CV AND A ONE-PAGE COVER LETTER TO JOBS@OPENWELLS.EXAMPLE
BY 31 OCTOBER 2026. ONLY SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES WILL BE CONTACTED.
